text: Front brake bites way too hard, almost threw me over the handlebars twice in city traffic.
Braking feels progressive and confident even in the rain, no complaints.
Rear brake makes a faint squeak sometimes but still stops fine.
Getting around 52 kmpl in mixed city and highway riding, better than my last bike.
Mileage dropped to 38 kmpl after the first service, not sure what changed.
Fuel efficiency is honestly nothing special, about what I expected for this segment.
Seat is rock hard, my back starts hurting after 40 minutes on the highway.
Seat cushioning is decent for short city commutes.
Indicator switch feels loose and rattles a bit, cheap plastic feel.
Kill switch and horn placement are intuitive, easy to reach without looking down.
Headlight is genuinely weak, barely lights up unlit stretches on the highway at night.
Headlight throw is average, fine for city roads with streetlights.
Service center kept my bike for 5 days for a basic first service, no updates unless I called them.
Service advisor was polite and explained every charge on the bill clearly.
Had to go back twice because they didn't fix the clutch noise the first time.
Engine pulls strong in first three gears, feels peppy for a 125.
Engine feels flat above 70 kmph, doesn't have much left after that.
Power delivery is smooth, no jerks even at low RPM in traffic.
Paint on the fuel tank started chipping within two months of normal use.
Panel gaps and fit finish are solid, doesn't feel cheap anywhere.
Footpegs buzz badly once you cross 80 kmph, my feet go numb on long rides.
Some vibration on the mirrors at idle but nothing major once moving.
Pillion seat is too narrow, my wife complains on anything longer than 20 minutes.
Pillion grab rail and footpeg position are comfortable for my father to ride behind me.
For the price, you're not getting anything a competitor doesn't already offer for less.
Genuinely feels like good value for money compared to what else is available in this price range.
Spare parts for this model are hard to find outside the city, had to wait a week for a switch part.
Local dealer had the part in stock same day, no issues getting accessories.
Bought it two weeks ago, still getting used to the riding position overall.
Overall happy with the purchase so far, would recommend to a friend.
